Trimming that works on real generated sprites, hard alpha and shrink-only resizing.

- **`--trim` ignores faint specks:** generated transparent images scatter pixels with alpha 1–16 over the background, which stopped `--trim` from cropping. They no longer count as visible.
- **`--hard-alpha[=n]`** makes every pixel fully solid or fully transparent, before trimming and again after resizing, for pixel art and crisp sprite edges. Palette quantization keeps hard alpha hard.
- **`--no-enlarge`** makes `--resize` a maximum size: smaller images keep their size.
